candidates: Do not add inline comments that merely restate what the immediately adjacent code already makes obvious (e.g., a comment like `// get the height of the bounding box of each member if exists` above a `getBBox()` call). Prefer self-documenting variable names; remove such explanatory prose before merging.

Do not use numbered or sequentially prefixed descriptions in `it()` / `cy` test blocks (e.g., 'test 1', 'should render diagram 2'). Write fully descriptive, standalone test strings; numbered formats are a deprecated convention in this project's spec files.

When adding snapshot or e2e tests to cover a rendering fix, verify that every distinct class-diagram syntax form affected by the fix has at least one test case — including standard class notation, string-label notation (`class A["label"]`), namespace blocks, and annotation syntax. Do not rely solely on the primary syntax form.
